evidence.approach: Three slices on the decisions clarify took (record 6). Slice 1 is the toolchain: fast-check and @fast-check/vitest, @stryker-mutator/core, vitest-runner and typescript-checker as devDependencies of @seen/core; packages/core/stryker.config.mjs mutating src/**/*.ts (tests excluded) with the vitest runner restricted to src and the typescript checker; packages/core/stryker.fixture.config.mjs mutating only the fixture; the fixture detector under packages/core/fixtures/tolerance/ in a correct and a seeded-bug form with an `invariant: ` property, and the convention written in workflow.md. Slice 2 is the harness: a new harness/mutation.py beside coverage.py, holding the fixed Stryker command, the reader of Stryker's JSON report (mutation-testing-report-schema, packages/core/reports/mutation/mutation.json) and the score over a set of files (killed plus timeout over killed, timeout, survived and no-coverage, with zero mutants reported as not applicable, never as 100). `harness mutation <ticket>` mirrors `harness coverage`: it mutates the packages/core/src files the accepted slices name and records a check with phase `mutation` carrying score, counts, files and floor. checks.demonstrates_failure gains a second form: a RED whose record carries `mutants_killed` (read from the report after a Stryker run, attached by cli.check) demonstrates failure even at exit 0; cited_check additionally requires one of those mutants to sit in a file the slice names. kpi.red_before_green and triage._red_check read demonstrates_failure instead of repeating the exit-code test. gates._tdd gains _require_mutation beside _require_coverage, applied only when a slice names a file under packages/core/src. kpi.measure carries `mutation` in both branches and report.py prints it beside coverage. Slice 3 is CI: a `mutation` job on Node only (no Supabase, since only the database-free tests run) that fetches the PR base, lists changed files under packages/core/src, restores the Stryker incremental file from the actions cache, runs Stryker with --incremental and --mutate on them, and exits clean when none changed. Why this shape: it puts the mutation measurement where the coverage one already is, so the gate, kpi and report each gain one sibling rather than a new mechanism, and the score is computed by the harness from the report rather than trusted from Stryker's exit code.

tests_first: The seeded tolerance bug is caught by the property. `pnpm --filter @seen/core test:fixtures`. RED: detector.test.ts asserts that fc.check of the `invariant: never raises inside the tolerance and always raises outside it` property finds a counterexample against seeded.ts and none against detector.ts; it fails because neither the fixture nor fast-check exists yet.

A Stryker report with a Killed mutant in a slice file is RED evidence at exit 0. `python3 -m unittest harness.tests.test_mutation -v`. RED: a check record with exit_code 0 and mutants_killed naming a slice file is refused by demonstrates_failure today.

The tdd gate refuses a packages/core/src slice below the floor. Same module plus `harness.tests.test_stage_gates`. RED: an attempt whose slice names packages/core/src/x.ts with a mutation check at score 60 against floor 70 advances today.

kpi.json and the sprint report carry the mutation figure. `python3 -m unittest harness.tests.test_kpi harness.tests.test_report -v`. RED: kpi.measure over records holding a mutation check returns no `mutation` key.

CI mutates only the changed files and skips when none changed. Evidence is the job run on this ticket's pull request, its duration quoted in the Outcome; no local RED is possible for a workflow file, which is stated rather than faked.

slices.name: Toolchain and the seeded-bug fixture proof
slices.red: The fixture property test fails before the fixture and fast-check exist; after, it finds a counterexample on seeded.ts and none on detector.ts, and a Stryker run with the fixture config reports the comparison-flipping mutant Killed.

slices.name: Killed mutant as RED, the floor gate, kpi and report
slices.red: A RED check at exit 0 whose record names a Killed mutant in a slice file is refused today, and an attempt whose packages/core/src slice measured a score below the floor advances today; kpi.measure carries no mutation field.

slices.name: Incremental mutation in CI
slices.red: No local RED for a workflow file: the job's first run on this ticket's pull request is the evidence, with a changed packages/core/src file mutated, an unchanged run skipping, and the duration under ten minutes quoted in the Outcome.

alternatives: Trust Stryker's --thresholds.break exit code as the floor: rejected, because the floor would then be a number in a Stryker config the gate cannot read, and the gate needs the score per file set, which only the JSON report gives.
Mutate the whole of packages/core including db/: rejected at clarify (record 6), the db tests need Supabase and hold no money arithmetic.
Put the fixture detector under harness/ as a Python fixture: rejected, the proof has to be Stryker and fast-check on TypeScript, the toolchain the money core will use.
A separate `harness check --phase mutation-red`: rejected, a new phase would need its own place in the RED/GREEN ordering at gates.py:1143; a RED of a second form keeps the ordering untouched.
risks: Stryker's vitest runner against vitest 3 and fileParallelism false (vitest.config.ts:17): mitigated by restricting Stryker to src tests and measuring in slice 1 before any harness code depends on it.

packages/core/src holds only index.ts today, so the product score is near empty: the not-applicable rule (zero mutants) keeps the gate from passing or failing on nothing, and the fixture carries the real proof.
The CI job exceeds ten minutes: measured on this PR; incremental mode plus mutating only changed files keeps it to the files a ticket touches.
knip calling the new devDependencies unused: the Stryker plugins are referenced from the config, which knip reads; any remaining entry is declared in knip.json, not suppressed globally.
Every harness test that builds a thresholds file breaks once [mutation] is in EXPECTED: helpers.py is in slice 2's files for that reason.
evidence.rollback: Revert the merge commit. Nothing persists outside the repository: no table, no secret, no deployed service. The thresholds section and the gate leave together, and a journal recorded under the gate stays readable because the mutation check is an ordinary check record.
